curated.description: Fed operating framework where bank reserves are constrained, affecting overnight rates and requiring active Fed intervention.
Hedge fund arbitrage between Treasury cash and futures, creating leveraged exposure that can amplify market stress.

Too much AI computing capacity could push AI-linked loans into default and send stocks down much harder than in a normal down year. The trigger to watch is a wave of big listings over the next 12 to 18 months: SpaceX, then Anthropic and OpenAI.

curated.description: A cap on how much investors can pull out of a fund in a given period. When redemption requests run past the cap, the fund holds back money, which shows its assets are harder to sell than its payouts promised.
curated.first_source: James Elbaor (Marlton LLC) on Monetary Matters with Jack Farley

curated.description: Tons of cargo multiplied by the miles they travel. When cargo has to go a longer way, the same amount needs more ships, so a short disruption can make ships scarce and push rates up, while a lasting shutdown that removes the cargo pushes them down.
curated.first_source: J Mintzmyer (Value Investors Edge) on Monetary Matters with Jack Farley
